description.zh: 科学计算器模块，支持四则运算、三角函数、对数、阶乘、排列组合、表达式解析等
description.en: Scientific calculator with arithmetic, trigonometry, logarithms, factorials, combinations and expression parsing

desc.zh: 计算纯数学表达式，仅支持数字和数学运算：运算符(+,-,*,/,^,%)、函数(sin,cos,tan,asin,acos,atan,sinh,cosh,tanh,sqrt,cbrt,abs,ceil,floor,round,ln,log,log10,log2,pow,mod,max,min,deg,rad,fact,perm,comb)、常量(pi,e)。不支持变量、字符串操作或length等函数。示例：2+3*4、sqrt(16)、sin(pi/2)
desc.en: Evaluate a pure math expression. Only supports numbers and math operations: operators(+,-,*,/,^,%), functions(sin,cos,tan,asin,acos,atan,sinh,cosh,tanh,sqrt,cbrt,abs,ceil,floor,round,ln,log,log10,log2,pow,mod,max,min,deg,rad,fact,perm,comb), constants(pi,e). Does NOT support variables, string operations or functions like length(). Examples: 2+3*4, sqrt(16), sin(pi/2)

zh: 纯数学表达式，只能包含数字、运算符和数学函数
en: Pure math expression, only numbers, operators and math functions

description.zh: 文件管理器模块，支持目录遍历、文件增删改查、搜索等操作
description.en: File manager with directory browsing, file CRUD, search and more

permissions.name: android.permission.MANAGE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE
permissions.desc_zh: 用于访问手机存储中的文件和目录，支持浏览、搜索、复制、移动和删除文件
permissions.desc_en: Access files and directories on device storage for browsing, searching, copying, moving and deleting

desc.zh: 获取文件信息(大小、修改时间等)
desc.en: Get file info (size, modification time, etc.)

description.zh: 文件压缩解压模块，支持ZIP(含密码加密)、TAR、GZ、TAR.GZ格式
description.en: Archive module supporting ZIP (with password), TAR, GZ, TAR.GZ formats

permissions.name: android.permission.MANAGE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE
permissions.desc_zh: 用于读取和写入手机存储中的压缩包与解压目录
permissions.desc_en: Read and write archive files and extraction directories on device storage

zh: 输入文件路径列表(逗号分隔)
输入文件路径列表(逗号分隔)
输入文件路径列表(逗号分隔)

description.zh: 签名校验模块，校验APK安装包和所有已加载模块的签名状态（区分官方签名和开发者签名），展示开发者信息、签名指纹、签名主体，确保应用和模块的完整性与合法性
description.en: Verify APK and module signatures (official & developer), display fingerprints and developer info to ensure integrity

desc.zh: 校验当前APK安装包的签名信息，返回签名证书指纹、包名、签发者
desc.en: Verify current APK signature, returns certificate fingerprint, package name, and issuer

desc.zh: 校验指定模块的签名，区分官方签名和开发者签名，返回签名类型、开发者信息、签名指纹
desc.en: Verify a specific module's signature, distinguish official vs developer signing, returns signature type, developer info, and fingerprint

desc.zh: 校验设备上所有已安装模块的签名，逐个列出校验结果，包含签名类型和开发者信息
desc.en: Verify signatures of all installed modules, list results with signature type and developer info

desc.zh: 一次性校验APK安装包签名和全部模块签名，返回完整报告（含签名类型、开发者信息）
desc.en: Verify both APK and all module signatures at once, returns a full report with signature types and developer info

description.zh: 应用管理模块，支持获取已安装应用列表、打开应用、查看应用详情、卸载应用、跳转系统设置应用信息页，并可获取和调用已审核的 PandaGenie SDK 可交互应用能力。
description.en: Manage apps: list installed apps, launch apps, view details, request uninstall, open system app info, and fetch or invoke approved PandaGenie SDK interactable app capabilities.

permissions.name: android.permission.INTERNET
permissions.desc: 用于从 PandaGenie 服务端获取已审核的可交互应用与能力列表。
permissions.desc_en: Fetch approved interactable SDK apps and capabilities from PandaGenie server.

permissions.name: android.permission.REQUEST_DELETE_PACKAGES
permissions.desc: 用于请求卸载应用。
permissions.desc_en: Request to uninstall applications.

apis.name: listApps
apis.desc: 仅用于获取已安装应用列表，包含应用名和包名。用户询问有哪些应用、列出所有应用时使用。
apis.desc_en: List installed apps with package name and app name. Use when the user asks to list or show all apps.
paramDesc: 是否包含系统应用，true 或 false，默认 false。
paramDesc_en: Include system apps, true or false. Default false.

apis.name: listRecentApps
apis.desc: 获取最近安装或更新的应用列表，按时间排序。用户询问最近安装了什么、这个月装了哪些应用时使用。
apis.desc_en: List recently installed or updated apps, sorted by time. Use when the user asks about recent or new apps, or apps installed this week/month.
paramDesc: 查询最近多少天的应用，默认 30。
是否包含系统应用，默认 false。
排序字段：firstInstallTime 表示首次安装，lastUpdateTime 表示最后更新。
paramDesc_en: Number of days to look back. Default 30.

apis.name: listCallableApps
apis.desc: 从 PandaGenie 服务端获取最新已审核的可交互、可调用应用列表及能力。只用于回答哪些应用可以被操作、交互、调用，或有哪些 SDK 应用能力；如果用户要求打开或执行某个能力，不要停在此接口，应继续使用 invokeCallableApp。
apis.desc_en: Fetch the latest approved interactable/callable app list and capabilities from PandaGenie server. Use only to answer which apps can be operated, interacted with, called, or what SDK capabilities are available. If the user asks to open or run a capability, continue with invokeCallableApp.
paramDesc: 按应用名、包名或能力关键词搜索，可为空。
是否只显示本机已安装应用，默认 false。
paramDesc_en: Search by app name, package name, or capability keyword. Optional.
Only show apps installed on this device. Default false.

apis.name: invokeCallableApp
apis.desc: 调用已安装且已审核的可交互 SDK 应用能力。用户要求打开演示页、打开 SDK 页面、调用演示能力、读取 Provider 数据、触发广播演示等时使用；不要只调用 listCallableApps 介绍有哪些能力。演示应用建议优先填写 capabilityId，例如 demo.open_activity、demo.provider_rows。
apis.desc_en: Invoke a capability exposed by an installed and approved interactable SDK app. Use when the user asks to open a demo page, open an SDK page, invoke a demo capability, read Provider data, trigger a broadcast demo, and similar actions. Do not only call listCallableApps.
paramDesc: 应用名称或包名，可为空；为空时按能力关键词匹配本机已安装的可交互应用。
能力 ID，建议优先填写，例如 demo.open_activity、demo.provider_rows；为空时会按关键词匹配。
能力关键词，例如打开演示页面、读取 Provider 数据；如果已知 capabilityId，仍可填写便于展示。
传给目标能力的 JSON 参数，可为空。
传给打开页面类能力的标题，可为空。
传给打开页面类能力的内容，可为空。
paramDesc_en: App name or package. Optional; when empty, PandaGenie matches installed interactable apps by capability keyword.
Capability ID. Prefer exact IDs such as demo.open_activity or demo.provider_rows. When empty, PandaGenie matches by keyword.
Capability keyword, for example open demo page or read Provider data. Can still be supplied for display when capabilityId is known.
JSON params passed to the target capability. Optional.
Title passed to open-page capabilities. Optional.
Message passed to open-page capabilities. Optional.

apis.name: openApp
apis.desc: 直接启动、打开、运行手机上的普通应用。当用户说打开 XX、启动 XX、运行 XX，且 XX 是普通手机应用名或包名时，直接调用此接口，只需要一个步骤，不需要先调用 getAppInfo 或 listApps。若用户说的是可交互 SDK 能力或演示页，应优先使用 invokeCallableApp。
apis.desc_en: Directly launch/open/run a normal app on the phone. When the user says open/launch/run XX and XX is a normal phone app name or package, call this action directly in one step without getAppInfo or listApps. If the user is asking for an interactable SDK capability or demo page, prefer invokeCallableApp.
paramDesc: 应用名或包名，例如微信、com.tencent.mm。
paramDesc_en: App name or package name, for example WeChat or com.tencent.mm.

apis.name: getAppInfo
apis.desc: 仅用于查询应用详细信息，如版本号、安装时间、来源等。只在用户明确要求查看或了解应用信息时使用，不要在打开应用前调用。
apis.desc_en: Only for querying app details such as version, install time, source, and similar metadata. Use only when the user explicitly asks to view/check app info. Do not call before openApp.

apis.name: uninstallApp
apis.desc: 请求卸载指定应用，会弹出系统确认对话框。
apis.desc_en: Request to uninstall an app. The system confirmation dialog will be shown.
paramDesc_en: Package name of the app to uninstall.

apis.name: openAppSettings
apis.desc: 打开系统设置中指定应用的详情页。用户说打开 XX 的设置、查看 XX 的权限时使用。
apis.desc_en: Open the system settings detail page for a specific app. Use when the user says open settings for XX or check permissions of XX.

description.zh: 文件信息统计模块，支持获取文件详情、魔术字识别真实文件类型、计算哈希值(MD5/SHA1/SHA256)、对比文件、校验完整性、目录统计、查找重复文件、大文件扫描、查询空文件和空文件夹、文件名关键词搜索、文本统计等
description.en: File statistics module: file details, magic bytes detection for true file type, hash calculation (MD5/SHA1/SHA256), file comparison, checksum verification, directory stats, duplicate finder, large file scanner, empty file/folder finder, filename search, text stats

desc.zh: 用于读取手机存储中的文件信息
desc.en: Read file information from device storage

desc.zh: 获取文件的完整信息，包括大小、创建时间、修改时间、文件类型、MIME类型、魔术字识别（APK/ZIP/PNG/JPG/MP4/PDF等）、扩展名不匹配检测、是否隐藏、可读/可写状态等
desc.en: Get comprehensive file info: size, created/modified time, file type, MIME, magic bytes detection (APK/ZIP/PNG/JPG/MP4/PDF etc.), extension mismatch check, hidden, readable/writable status

desc.zh: 计算文件的哈希值，支持MD5、SHA-1、SHA-256算法。用于校验文件完整性、判断文件是否被修改
desc.en: Calculate file hash using MD5, SHA-1 or SHA-256. For integrity checks and modification detection

desc.zh: 对比两个文件是否完全相同。先比较大小，大小一致再比较SHA-256哈希。返回是否相同及差异详情
desc.en: Compare two files for equality. Compares size first, then SHA-256 hash. Returns whether identical and difference details

zh: 第一个文件的绝对路径
第二个文件的绝对路径

desc.zh: 用已知的哈希值校验文件完整性，判断文件是否与预期一致
desc.en: Verify file integrity against a known hash value

desc.zh: 统计目录信息：总大小、文件数量、子目录数量、按扩展名分类的文件数量和大小分布
desc.en: Directory statistics: total size, file count, subdirectory count, breakdown by extension

zh: 目录路径；全盘/根目录扫描时可留空，App 会统一授权并由模块使用手机存储根目录
是否递归统计子目录(true/false，默认true)
en: Directory path; leave blank for full/root storage scan so the app can authorize access and the module uses the device storage root

desc.zh: 在指定目录中查找重复文件（内容完全相同的文件），按SHA-256哈希分组返回
desc.en: Find duplicate files in a directory by SHA-256 hash, grouped by identical content

zh: 目录路径；全盘/根目录扫描时可留空，App 会统一授权并由模块使用手机存储根目录
最小文件大小过滤，单位字节(默认1024，跳过小文件)
en: Directory path; leave blank for full/root storage scan so the app can authorize access and the module uses the device storage root
Minimum file size filter in bytes (default 1024, skip tiny files)

desc.zh: 在指定目录中查找超过指定大小的文件，按大小降序排列
desc.en: Find files exceeding a size threshold in a directory, sorted by size descending

zh: 目录路径；全盘/根目录扫描时可留空，App 会统一授权并由模块使用手机存储根目录
en: Directory path; leave blank for full/root storage scan so the app can authorize access and the module uses the device storage root

desc.zh: 在指定目录中查询空文件和空文件夹，不执行删除。空文件按0字节判断，空文件夹按目录下没有任何子项判断
desc.en: Find empty files and empty folders in a directory without deleting them. Empty files are zero-byte files; empty folders contain no children

zh: 目录路径；全盘/根目录扫描时可留空，App 会统一授权并由模块使用手机存储根目录
是否递归扫描子目录(true/false，默认true)
是否包含隐藏文件和隐藏目录(true/false，默认false)
是否允许把根目录本身作为空文件夹返回(true/false，默认false)
最多返回条数(默认200，最大2000)
en: Directory path; leave blank for full/root storage scan so the app can authorize access and the module uses the device storage root
Include hidden files and hidden folders (true/false, default false)
Allow the root directory itself to be returned as an empty folder (true/false, default false)

desc.zh: 在指定目录中按文件名关键词搜索文件，支持多个关键词(逗号分隔)，支持大小写不敏感匹配
desc.en: Search files by filename keyword in a directory. Supports multiple keywords (comma-separated), case-insensitive

zh: 目录路径；全盘/根目录搜索时可留空，App 会统一授权并由模块使用手机存储根目录
文件名关键词(多个用逗号分隔)
en: Directory path; leave blank for full/root storage search so the app can authorize access and the module uses the device storage root

desc.zh: 统计文本文件的行数、单词数、字符数、空行数、非空行数
desc.en: Count lines, words, characters, blank lines, non-blank lines of a text file

en: Absolute path of a text file

desc.zh: 批量获取多个文件的基本信息（大小、修改时间、哈希），路径用逗号分隔
desc.en: Get basic info (size, modified time, hash) for multiple files. Paths separated by commas

zh: 文件路径列表(逗号分隔)

description.zh: 提醒助手模块，支持创建/查询/修改/删除日历事件、设置闹钟和倒计时、生日提醒、查看近期日程等
description.en: Reminder assistant: create/query/update/delete calendar events, set alarms and timers, birthday reminders, view upcoming schedule

desc.zh: 用于读取日历中的事件和提醒
用于创建、修改和删除日历事件
desc.en: Create, update and delete calendar events

apis.name: createEvent
apis.desc: 在日历中创建事件/提醒，支持设置标题、描述、开始/结束时间、地点、重复规则、提前提醒分钟数
apis.desc_en: Create a calendar event/reminder with title, description, start/end time, location, repeat rule, and reminder minutes
paramDesc: 开始时间，格式: yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm
结束时间，格式: yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm(可为空，默认开始后1小时)
paramDesc_en: End time, format: yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm (optional, default 1 hour after start)

apis.name: listEvents
apis.desc: 查询指定日期范围内的日历事件列表
apis.desc_en: Query calendar events within a date range
paramDesc: 结束日期，格式: yyyy-MM-dd(可为空，默认startDate当天)
paramDesc_en: End date, format: yyyy-MM-dd (optional, defaults to same day)

apis.name: updateEvent
apis.desc: 修改已有的日历事件，可更新标题、描述、时间、地点等
apis.desc_en: Update an existing calendar event (title, description, time, location, etc.)
paramDesc: 新开始时间(不修改传空)
新结束时间(不修改传空)

apis.name: deleteEvent
apis.desc: 删除指定的日历事件
apis.desc_en: Delete a calendar event

apis.name: getCalendars
apis.desc: 列出设备上所有可用的日历账户，返回日历ID、名称、账户等信息
apis.desc_en: List all available calendar accounts on the device with ID, name, and account info

apis.name: setAlarm
apis.desc: 设置系统闹钟，会打开系统闹钟设置界面
apis.desc_en: Set a system alarm clock, opens system alarm UI
paramDesc: 重复星期，逗号分隔: 1=周一...7=周日(可为空表示不重复)
paramDesc_en: Repeat days, comma-separated: 1=Mon...7=Sun (empty for no repeat)

apis.name: setTimer
apis.desc: 设置倒计时，会打开系统倒计时界面
apis.desc_en: Set a countdown timer, opens system timer UI

apis.name: createBirthdayReminder
apis.desc: 创建每年重复的生日提醒事件，自动设置为全天事件并每年重复
apis.desc_en: Create a yearly recurring birthday reminder as an all-day event
paramDesc: 生日日期，格式: MM-dd 或 yyyy-MM-dd
提前提醒分钟数(默认1440即1天前)
paramDesc_en: Birthday date, format: MM-dd or yyyy-MM-dd

apis.name: openCalendar
apis.desc: 打开系统日历应用，可指定跳转到某一天
apis.desc_en: Open the system calendar app, optionally jump to a specific date
paramDesc: 要查看的日期，格式: yyyy-MM-dd(可为空，打开当天)
paramDesc_en: Date to view, format: yyyy-MM-dd (optional, opens today)

apis.name: getUpcoming
apis.desc: 获取未来N天内的所有日历事件摘要
apis.desc_en: Get a summary of all calendar events in the next N days
paramDesc: 查询未来几天的事件(默认7天)
paramDesc_en: Number of days to look ahead (default 7)

apis.name: openPage
apis.desc: 打开提醒助手的指定页面并返回 _openModule 信号，页面值: tools(提醒工具), upcoming(近期日程)
apis.desc_en: Open a specific Reminder page and return _openModule signal. Pages: tools, upcoming

description.zh: 文本工具模块，支持字数统计、Base64编解码、URL编解码、正则匹配替换、文本转换、UUID生成、文本哈希，以及通过大模型总结、改写、提取和整理文本。
description.en: Text tools: word count, Base64 encode/decode, URL encode/decode, regex match/replace, text transform, UUID generation, text hashing, plus LLM-powered summarization, rewriting, extraction and formatting.

apis.name: wordCount
apis.desc: 统计文本的字符数、词数、行数、句数、段数；中文按字计词，英文按空白分词
apis.desc_en: Count characters, words, lines, sentences, paragraphs; CJK ideographs count as one word each, English words by whitespace

apis.name: base64Encode
apis.desc: 将文本按 UTF-8 编码为 Base64 字符串
apis.desc_en: Encode text to Base64 (UTF-8 bytes)

apis.name: base64Decode
apis.desc: 将 Base64 解码为 UTF-8 文本
apis.desc_en: Decode Base64 to UTF-8 text

apis.name: urlEncode
apis.desc: URL 编码（application/x-www-form-urlencoded，空格为 +）
apis.desc_en: URL encode (application/x-www-form-urlencoded; space as +)

apis.name: urlDecode
apis.desc: URL 解码
apis.desc_en: URL decode

apis.name: regexMatch
apis.desc: 在文本中查找正则表达式的全部匹配子串
apis.desc_en: Find all regex matches in text

apis.name: regexReplace
apis.desc: 用 replacement 替换正则匹配（支持 $1、$2 等分组引用）
apis.desc_en: Replace regex matches (supports $1, $2 group references)

apis.name: textTransform
apis.desc: 文本变换：upper/lower/capitalize/reverse/trim
apis.desc_en: Transform: upper, lower, capitalize, reverse, trim
paramDesc_en: Transform: upper, lower, capitalize, reverse, trim

apis.name: generateUUID
apis.desc: 生成随机 UUID（RFC 4122 随机型）
apis.desc_en: Generate a random UUID (RFC 4122)

apis.name: hashText
apis.desc: 计算文本 UTF-8 字节的哈希，algorithm：MD5、SHA-1、SHA-256（大小写不敏感）
apis.desc_en: Hash UTF-8 bytes of text; algorithm: MD5, SHA-1, SHA-256 (case-insensitive)

apis.name: aiProcessText
apis.desc: 使用大模型对文本进行总结、润色改写、信息提取、格式整理、分类判断或按用户指令处理。适合用户说“总结这段话”“帮我改写”“提取要点”“整理成清单”等。
apis.desc_en: Use the app-provided LLM to summarize, rewrite, extract, format, classify, translate or process text by instruction.
paramDesc: 用户补充要求，例如语气、输出格式、需要提取的字段
输出语言，默认跟随系统语言
最多输入字符数，默认 6000，最大 12000
最多输出 token，官方模型会限制在 1024 内
paramDesc_en: Extra user instruction such as tone, output format, or fields to extract
Output language, default follows system language
Maximum output tokens; official provider is capped at 1024

description.zh: 设备信息模块，提供机型与系统版本、CPU、内存、存储、屏幕参数及一键汇总，仅使用系统公开 API。
description.en: Device information module: model/OS, CPU, RAM, storage, display metrics, and one-call summary using public Android APIs only.

apis.name: getDeviceInfo
apis.desc: 获取品牌、型号、制造商、Android 版本、SDK 级别、构建号与系统指纹等基础信息，用户说【设备信息】【手机型号】【系统版本】时使用
apis.desc_en: Brand, model, manufacturer, Android version, SDK level, build number, and build fingerprint — use when the user asks for device or OS basics.

apis.name: getCpuInfo
apis.desc: 读取 /proc/cpuinfo 并返回处理器数量与架构等 CPU 信息，用户说【CPU】【处理器】【几核】时使用
apis.desc_en: Read /proc/cpuinfo plus processor count and architecture — use for CPU / core count questions.

apis.name: getMemoryInfo
apis.desc: 通过 ActivityManager 获取内存总量、可用、已用与占用比例，用户说【内存】【运存】【RAM】时使用
apis.desc_en: RAM total, available, used, and usage percent via ActivityManager.MemoryInfo.

apis.name: getStorageInfo
apis.desc: 使用 StatFs 与 Environment 获取内部存储与外部主存储的总空间、可用与已用，用户说【存储】【空间】【硬盘】时使用
apis.desc_en: Internal and primary external storage total, available, and used via StatFs and Environment.

apis.name: getDisplayInfo

paramDesc: 相册名，建议传 all 扫描全部可见相册；也可传具体相册名
最多返回候选数量，默认 50
paramDesc_en: Album name; use all for all visible gallery images or pass a specific album

apis.name: findDuplicateImages

paramDesc: 相册名，默认 default/Camera；all 表示全部相册
参与查重的最小文件大小，默认 1 字节
paramDesc_en: Album name; default reads Camera/DCIM; use all for the whole gallery
Minimum file size to compare, default 1 byte

apis.name: findSimilarImages
apis.desc: 按用户要求扫描默认相册、全部相册或指定相册，使用感知哈希、均值哈希和颜色特征查找相似照片、压缩副本和缩略图候选；只返回 image_groups 结构化富内容，模块负责分组列表、建议保留、候选标签和 deleteRecommendation，APP 负责通用文件选择、删除确认和真实删除。默认首轮会限量限时，只有 fullScan=true 才完整扫描。
apis.desc_en: Scan the default album, all albums, or a named album as requested, using perceptual hashes, average hashes, and color profiles to find similar photos, compressed copies, and thumbnail candidates. Returns only structured image_groups rich content: the module provides grouped file lists, suggested keeps, review candidates, labels, and deleteRecommendation flags; the app provides generic file selection, delete confirmation, and deletion execution. The first pass is capped and time-limited unless fullScan=true. If no high-confidence group is found, it returns the nearest manual-review pairs. Use for requests like find similar photos, group candidates, suggest which one to keep, and do not delete yet.
paramDesc: 相册范围：默认相册/相机胶卷用 default；用户明确说全部/所有相册时用 all；也可以传具体相册名
最大扫描图片数，默认 5000；未开启 fullScan 时会保护性限制到 300 张，避免首次扫描过慢
严格视觉指纹最大汉明距离，默认 14，越小越严格
宽松候选最大汉明距离，默认 24；只作为人工复核候选，不代表可以自动删除
宽高比容差，默认 0.25；截图、裁剪图较多时可放宽到 0.35
参与比较的最短边像素，默认 32 像素
最多返回的相似分组数，默认 50
是否完整扫描，默认 false；只有用户明确要求全量扫描时才设为 true
模块内部限时，毫秒，默认 65000，用于避免超过 App 执行超时
paramDesc_en: Album name: use default for default album/camera roll, all only when the user asks for all albums, or pass a named album
Maximum images to scan, default 5000; capped to 300 unless fullScan is true to avoid slow first scans
Strict visual-hash Hamming distance, default 14; lower is stricter
Loose candidate Hamming distance, default 24; only for manual review candidates, never automatic delete decisions
Aspect ratio tolerance, default 0.25; use 0.35 for a looser scan
Minimum short edge to compare, default 32 px
Maximum groups to return, default 50; result groups are review candidates and must not be deleted automatically
Whether to run a full scan. Default false; set true only when the user explicitly asks for a full/all-album scan
Internal module time budget in milliseconds, default 65000, used to finish before the app execution timeout

apis.desc_en: Apply a template to banner by name with display text, returns full banner config

description.zh: 系统清理模块，扫描并清理临时文件、缓存、空文件夹、缩略图缓存和APK安装包等，释放存储空间
description.en: System cleaner: scan and clean temp files, cache, empty folders, thumbnail cache, and APK installer files to free storage space

permissions.name: android.permission.MANAGE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE
permissions.desc: 用于读取手机存储信息、查找大文件和扫描可清理文件；清理前会由用户确认
permissions.desc_en: Read device storage information, find large files, and scan cleanable files; cleanup requires user confirmation

apis.name: scanJunk

apis.name: cleanJunk

清理路径（留空使用手机存储根目录，由 App 统一授权）
paramDesc_en: Path to clean (leave blank to use the device storage root through App sandbox authorization)

apis.name: getStorageInfo

apis.desc_en: Find large files that may be candidates for cleanup
paramDesc: 扫描路径（留空使用手机存储根目录，由 App 统一授权）
paramDesc_en: Path to scan (leave blank to use the device storage root through App sandbox authorization)

apis.name: openPage

apis.desc_en: Open the System Cleaner UI and return _openModule signal

description.zh: 颜色拾取与转换：HEX、RGB、HSL、CMYK 互转；和谐色板（互补、类似、三角、分裂互补、四色）；随机色；CSS 命名色匹配
description.en: Color picker and conversion across HEX, RGB, HSL, CMYK; harmonious palettes (complementary, analogous, triadic, split-complementary, tetradic); random colors; closest CSS named color lookup

apis.name: convertColor
apis.desc: 在 HEX (#RRGGBB)、RGB、HSL、CMYK 之间转换；fromFormat/toFormat 为 hex|rgb|hsl|cmyk，toFormat 可为 all 返回全部
apis.desc_en: Convert between HEX (#RRGGBB), RGB, HSL, CMYK; fromFormat/toFormat: hex|rgb|hsl|cmyk; use toFormat=all for all formats
paramDesc_en: Color string e.g. #FF0000, 255,0,0, hsl triple, or CMYK quad

apis.name: generatePalette
apis.desc: 根据基色与和谐类型生成色板：complementary|analogous|triadic|split-complementary|tetradic
apis.desc_en: Generate a palette from a base color; harmony: complementary|analogous|triadic|split-complementary|tetradic
paramDesc_en: Harmony: complementary, analogous, triadic, split-complementary, tetradic

apis.name: randomColor
apis.desc: 生成随机颜色；可选 hueMin/hueMax（0–360）限制色相范围
apis.desc_en: Random color(s); optional hueMin/hueMax (0–360) to constrain hue

apis.name: getColorInfo
apis.desc: 根据 HEX 返回最接近的 CSS 命名颜色名称与距离
apis.desc_en: Closest CSS named color for a given HEX, with distance

description.zh: 万能单位转换模块，支持长度、重量、温度、面积、体积、速度、时间、数据存储等多种单位互转
description.en: Universal unit converter: length, weight, temperature, area, volume, speed, time, data storage, and more

apis.name: convert
apis.desc: 在指定类别下将数值从源单位转换为目标单位；类别：length|weight|temperature|area|volume|speed|time|data
apis.desc_en: Convert a value between units; category: length|weight|temperature|area|volume|speed|time|data

apis.name: listUnits
apis.desc: 列出某类别下所有可用单位标识
apis.desc_en: List all available units in a category

apis.name: listCategories
apis.desc: 列出所有支持的转换类别
apis.desc_en: List all supported conversion categories

apis.name: openPage
apis.desc: 打开单位转换界面并返回 _openModule 信号
apis.desc_en: Open the Unit Converter UI and return _openModule signal

description.zh: 安全密码生成器模块，支持自定义长度、复杂度和字符类型生成强密码，还支持助记密码短语生成和密码强度检测
description.en: Secure password generator: create strong passwords with customizable length, complexity, and character types. Also includes passphrase generation and password strength checker.

apis.name: generate
apis.desc: 生成加密安全的随机密码，可配置长度与字符类型
apis.desc_en: Generate a random secure password
paramDesc: 包含大写字母（默认 true）
包含小写字母（默认 true）

apis.name: generateMultiple
apis.desc: 一次生成多条随机密码
apis.desc_en: Generate multiple random passwords at once
apis.description: Generate multiple random passwords at once

apis.name: generatePassphrase
apis.desc: 从词表随机选词生成易记短语密码
apis.desc_en: Generate a memorable passphrase from random words
apis.description: Generate a memorable passphrase from random words

apis.name: checkStrength
apis.desc: 分析密码强度并给出建议
apis.desc_en: Analyze the strength of a given password
apis.description: Analyze the strength of a given password

description.zh: 二维码工具模块，支持从文本/URL生成二维码、从图片识别解码二维码、查看和分享生成的二维码
description.en: QR code tools: generate QR codes from text or URLs, decode QR codes from images, view and share generated codes

permissions.name: android.permission.WRITE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE
permissions.desc: 用于将生成的二维码保存到 PandaGenie 目录
permissions.desc_en: Save generated QR images under the PandaGenie folder

permissions.name: android.permission.READ_EXTERNAL_STORAGE
permissions.desc: 用于读取图片以解码二维码
permissions.desc_en: Read image files for QR decoding

apis.name: generateQR
apis.desc: 从文本或 URL 生成二维码 PNG 并保存到存储，返回文件路径和图片预览
apis.desc_en: Generate a QR code PNG from text or URL, returns file path and image preview
paramDesc: 输出图片边长（像素），默认 512
是否附带 PNG 的 Base64 预览，默认否
paramDesc_en: Output image side length in pixels, default 512
Include PNG as Base64 for preview, default false

apis.name: decodeQR
apis.desc: 扫描指定路径的图片，提取并返回二维码中的文本内容
apis.desc_en: Scan an image at the given path and extract QR code text content
paramDesc: 包含二维码的图片绝对路径

apis.name: detectQR

paramDesc: 要检测的图片绝对路径
paramDesc_en: Absolute path to image to check for QR code

apis.name: listGenerated
apis.desc: 列出已保存到 PandaGenie/qrcode 目录下的二维码图片列表
apis.desc_en: List QR code PNG files saved under PandaGenie/qrcode

apis.name: openPage
apis.desc: 打开二维码工具的指定页面并返回 _openModule 信号，页面值: gen(生成), scan(相机扫描), gal(图库)
apis.desc_en: Open a specific QR tool page and return _openModule signal. Pages: gen(generate), scan(camera scan), gal(gallery)

description.zh: 经典贪吃蛇游戏，控制蛇移动吃掉食物增加长度，避免碰到墙壁和自身，支持设置难度
description.en: Classic Snake game. Control the snake to eat food and grow longer while avoiding walls and yourself. Supports difficulty settings

apis.name: startGame
apis.desc: 开始贪吃蛇游戏，可设置难度（1-3：简单/普通/困难），返回初始游戏状态
apis.desc_en: Start a new Snake game. Set difficulty (1-3: easy/normal/hard). Returns initial game state

apis.name: move
apis.desc: 控制蛇移动一步，方向为 up/down/left/right，返回移动后的游戏状态
apis.desc_en: Move the snake one step in the given direction (up/down/left/right). Returns updated game state

apis.name: getState
apis.desc: 获取当前游戏状态，包括蛇的位置、食物位置、得分、是否结束等
apis.desc_en: Get current game state including snake position, food position, score, game over status

apis.name: restart
apis.desc: 重新开始游戏，保持当前难度设置
apis.desc_en: Restart the game with current difficulty setting

description.zh: 种菜模拟游戏，选择种子种植，浇水、施肥、除草帮助植物生长，收获结果可保存记录，支持定时任务，只有一个存档
description.en: Farming simulation game. Plant seeds, water, fertilize and weed to help plants grow. Save harvest records. Supports scheduled tasks. Single save slot

permissions.name: android.permission.MANAGE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE
permissions.desc: 用于保存游戏进度和收获记录
permissions.desc_en: Save game progress and harvest records

apis.name: startGame
apis.desc: 开始新的种菜游戏（如已有存档将被覆盖），初始化空田地
apis.desc_en: Start a new farming game (overwrites existing save). Initialize empty farm plots

apis.name: enterGame
apis.desc: 进入已有的种菜游戏（加载存档），如无存档则自动创建新游戏
apis.desc_en: Enter existing farming game (load save). Auto-creates new game if no save exists

apis.name: plant
apis.desc: 在指定地块种植作物，可选种子类型：tomato/carrot/cabbage/corn/watermelon/strawberry
apis.desc_en: Plant a crop on the specified plot. Seed types: tomato/carrot/cabbage/corn/watermelon/strawberry

apis.name: water
apis.desc: 给指定地块浇水，促进植物生长
apis.desc_en: Water the specified plot to promote growth

apis.name: fertilize
apis.desc: 给指定地块施肥，加速植物生长
apis.desc_en: Fertilize the specified plot to accelerate growth

apis.name: weed
apis.desc: 给指定地块除草，防止杂草影响植物生长
apis.desc_en: Weed the specified plot to prevent weeds from affecting growth

apis.name: harvest
apis.desc: 收获指定地块的成熟作物，记录到收获历史
apis.desc_en: Harvest mature crop from the specified plot. Records to harvest history

apis.name: getState
apis.desc: 获取当前游戏状态，包括所有地块、作物状态、收获记录等
apis.desc_en: Get current game state including all plots, crop status, harvest records

apis.name: getHarvestHistory
apis.desc: 查看收获历史记录
apis.desc_en: View harvest history records

apis.name: saveGame
apis.desc: 手动保存当前游戏进度
apis.desc_en: Manually save current game progress

description.zh: 经典五子棋游戏，玩家（黑子）与程序（白子）在15x15棋盘上对战，率先五子连珠者获胜
description.en: Classic Gomoku (Five in a Row) game. Player (black) vs AI (white) on a 15x15 board. First to get five in a row wins

apis.name: startGame
apis.desc: 开始五子棋游戏，玩家执黑先手，返回初始棋盘状态
apis.desc_en: Start a new Gomoku game. Player plays black and goes first. Returns initial board state

apis.name: placeStone
apis.desc: 玩家在指定位置落子（行列从0开始），程序随后自动回应，返回更新后的棋盘状态
apis.desc_en: Player places a stone at the specified position (row/col 0-based). AI responds automatically. Returns updated board

apis.name: getState
apis.desc: 获取当前游戏状态，包括棋盘、当前回合、胜负情况等
apis.desc_en: Get current game state including board, current turn, win/loss status

apis.name: restart
apis.desc: 重新开始游戏
apis.desc_en: Restart the game

description.zh: 经典俄罗斯方块游戏，控制方块移动和旋转，将方块堆叠成完整行来消除得分，支持设置难度
description.en: Classic Tetris game. Control blocks to move and rotate, stack them to complete rows for points. Supports difficulty settings

apis.name: startGame
apis.desc: 开始俄罗斯方块游戏，可设置难度（1-3：简单/普通/困难），返回初始游戏状态
apis.desc_en: Start a new Tetris game. Set difficulty (1-3: easy/normal/hard). Returns initial game state

apis.name: move
apis.desc: 控制当前方块移动，方向为 left/right/down，返回移动后的游戏状态
apis.desc_en: Move current block (left/right/down). Returns updated game state

apis.name: rotate
apis.desc: 旋转当前方块，返回旋转后的游戏状态
apis.desc_en: Rotate the current block. Returns updated game state

apis.name: drop
apis.desc: 将当前方块直接下落到底部，返回下落后的游戏状态
apis.desc_en: Hard drop the current block to the bottom. Returns updated game state

apis.name: tick
apis.desc: 执行一次游戏时钟周期（方块自动下落一格），返回更新后的游戏状态
apis.desc_en: Execute one game tick (block falls one row). Returns updated game state

apis.name: getState
apis.desc: 获取当前游戏状态，包括棋盘、当前方块、下一个方块、得分、消除行数、是否结束等
apis.desc_en: Get current game state including board, current block, next block, score, lines cleared, game over status

apis.name: restart
apis.desc: 重新开始游戏，保持当前难度设置
apis.desc_en: Restart the game with current difficulty setting

description.zh: 经典数独游戏，在9x9网格中填入1-9，使每行、每列和每个3x3子网格都不重复，支持设置难度自动生成题目
description.en: Classic Sudoku game. Fill a 9x9 grid with digits 1-9 so each row, column and 3x3 box is unique. Supports difficulty-based puzzle generation

apis.name: startGame
apis.desc: 开始数独游戏，根据难度（1-3：简单/普通/困难）生成题目，返回初始棋盘
apis.desc_en: Start a new Sudoku game. Generate puzzle by difficulty (1-3: easy/normal/hard). Returns initial board

apis.name: placeNumber
apis.desc: 在指定位置填入数字，返回更新后的棋盘状态和是否正确
apis.desc_en: Place a number at the specified position. Returns updated board and correctness

apis.name: clearCell
apis.desc: 清除指定位置的数字（仅可清除玩家填入的数字），返回更新后的棋盘
apis.desc_en: Clear the number at the specified position (only player-placed numbers). Returns updated board

apis.name: checkBoard
apis.desc: 检查当前棋盘是否完成且正确，返回检查结果
apis.desc_en: Check if the current board is complete and correct. Returns check result

apis.name: getHint
apis.desc: 获取一个提示，返回一个空格的正确答案
apis.desc_en: Get a hint for one empty cell. Returns the correct answer

apis.name: getState
apis.desc: 获取当前游戏状态，包括棋盘、已填数量、是否完成等
apis.desc_en: Get current game state including board, filled count, completion status

apis.name: restart
apis.desc: 重新开始游戏，保持当前难度设置并生成新题目
apis.desc_en: Restart with current difficulty and generate a new puzzle

description.zh: 经典井字棋游戏，玩家（X）与程序（O）对战，在3x3网格中率先形成三连即获胜
description.en: Classic Tic-Tac-Toe game. Player (X) vs AI (O) on a 3x3 grid. First to get three in a row wins

apis.name: startGame
apis.desc: 开始井字棋游戏，玩家执X先手，返回初始棋盘状态
apis.desc_en: Start a new Tic-Tac-Toe game. Player plays X and goes first. Returns initial board state

apis.name: placeMark
apis.desc: 玩家在指定位置下棋（行列从0开始），程序随后自动回应，返回更新后的棋盘状态
apis.desc_en: Player places mark at the specified position (row/col 0-based). AI responds automatically. Returns updated board state

apis.name: getState
apis.desc: 获取当前游戏状态，包括棋盘、当前回合、胜负情况等
apis.desc_en: Get current game state including board, current turn, win/loss status

apis.name: restart
apis.desc: 重新开始游戏
apis.desc_en: Restart the game

description.zh: 链接解析模块，支持抓取网页内容、提取标题/描述/图片/链接/下载文件等信息，也可调用 AI 总结网页或回答页面相关问题
description.en: Parse URLs to extract titles, descriptions, images, links, downloadable files, and use AI to summarize pages or answer page-specific questions

permissions.name: android.permission.INTERNET
permissions.desc: 用于发送HTTP/HTTPS请求抓取链接内容
permissions.desc_en: Send HTTP/HTTPS requests to fetch URL content

apis.name: parseUrl
apis.desc: 解析链接，抓取网页内容并提取标题、描述、图片、链接、下载文件等全部信息，返回分类整理后的结果
apis.desc_en: Parse a URL: fetch content, extract title, description, images, links, downloadable files, and return categorized results

apis.name: getHeaders
apis.desc: 获取链接的HTTP响应头信息，包括Content-Type、Content-Length、Server、缓存策略、重定向等
apis.desc_en: Get HTTP response headers: Content-Type, Content-Length, Server, cache policy, redirects, etc.

apis.name: extractImages
apis.desc: 提取链接页面中的所有图片URL，包括img标签、og:image、背景图等
apis.desc_en: Extract all image URLs from a page: img tags, og:image, background images, etc.
paramDesc: 要提取图片的链接地址

apis.name: extractLinks
apis.desc: 提取页面中的所有超链接，分类为内部链接和外部链接
apis.desc_en: Extract all hyperlinks from a page, categorized as internal and external
paramDesc: 要提取链接的页面地址

apis.name: extractDownloads
apis.desc: 检测页面中的可下载文件链接（PDF、ZIP、APK、文档等），包括直接文件链接和下载按钮
apis.desc_en: Detect downloadable file links (PDF, ZIP, APK, docs, etc.) including direct file links and download buttons
paramDesc: 要检测下载链接的页面地址

apis.name: extractText
apis.desc: 提取页面的纯文本内容，去除HTML标签和脚本，保留正文结构
apis.desc_en: Extract plain text content from a page, stripping HTML tags and scripts while preserving structure
paramDesc: 要提取文本的链接地址

apis.name: summarizeUrl
apis.desc: 调用 AI 总结网页正文，或根据网页内容回答指定问题
apis.desc_en: Use AI to summarize a web page or answer a question based on page text
paramDesc: 要总结或问答的网页地址
处理模式，可选，默认 summary
针对网页提出的问题，可选
输出语言，可选，默认跟随系统语言
最多送入模型的网页正文字符数，可选
模型最大输出 token，可选
paramDesc_en: URL to summarize or ask about
Output language, optional, defaults to system language
Max page text characters sent to the model, optional

apis.name: checkUrl
apis.desc: 检查链接是否可访问，返回状态码、响应时间、重定向链、SSL证书信息等
apis.desc_en: Check URL accessibility: status code, response time, redirect chain, SSL certificate info

apis.name: extractMeta
apis.desc: 提取页面的元数据：Open Graph、Twitter Card、favicon、RSS/Atom feed、结构化数据等
apis.desc_en: Extract page metadata: Open Graph, Twitter Card, favicon, RSS/Atom feeds, structured data
paramDesc: 要提取元数据的链接地址

apis.name: openPage
apis.desc: 打开链接解析界面并返回 _openModule 信号
apis.desc_en: Open the Link Parser UI and return _openModule signal

description.zh: 天气助手模块，支持查询城市当前天气、多日天气预报，以及今天和明天的气温/天气变化预警；当用户询问穿衣、出行、带伞、温差时，把核心建议放在主输出顶部，使用 Open-Meteo 免费 API，无需密钥
description.en: Weather assistant module for current weather, multi-day forecasts, and today-vs-tomorrow alerts. When users ask about clothing, travel, umbrellas, or temperature changes, it highlights practical advice at the top of the main output using the free Open-Meteo API.

permissions.name: android.permission.INTERNET
permissions.desc: 用于查询天气 API 获取天气数据
permissions.desc_en: Access weather API for weather data

permissions.name: android.permission.ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION
permissions.desc: 用于获取精确位置以查询当前位置天气
permissions.desc_en: Get precise location for local weather

permissions.name: android.permission.ACCESS_COARSE_LOCATION
permissions.desc: 用于获取大致位置以查询当前位置天气
permissions.desc_en: Get approximate location for local weather

apis.name: getCurrentWeather
apis.desc: 查询指定城市的当前天气；city 为空时自动使用 GPS 定位获取当地天气
apis.desc_en: Get current weather for a city; if city is empty, auto-detect location via GPS
paramDesc: 城市名称（可选，留空则自动定位）
paramDesc_en: City name (optional, empty to use GPS location)

apis.name: getForecast
apis.desc: 查询指定城市未来多日天气预报；city 为空时自动使用 GPS 定位
apis.desc_en: Get multi-day forecast; if city is empty, auto-detect location via GPS
paramDesc: 城市名称（可选，留空则自动定位）
paramDesc_en: City name (optional, empty to use GPS location)

apis.name: getTemperatureAlert

apis.desc_en: Analyze a page or direct URL for downloadable files. Use this when the user asks to parse a link and find packages, documents, archives, media, etc. It extracts href/src/download buttons, detects direct file URLs, and when fileName or extensions are provided, constructs likely download URLs from the current URL directory and lightly probes them. To download, call this first then downloadFile; if the user asks to download the best match directly, call downloadBestCandidate.
paramDesc: 要分析的网页地址或文件直链，支持 http/https；如果用户只给域名也可传入
可选，用户期望的文件名或文件名前缀，例如 app-release.apk、manual、report；传入后会在链接所在目录下构造候选下载链接
可选，期望文件扩展名数组或逗号分隔字符串，例如 apk,pdf,zip,docx；未提供时默认覆盖常见文档、压缩包、安装包、图片、音视频
可选，筛选关键词数组或逗号分隔字符串，例如 下载,release,manual；用于提高候选排序
是否探测候选链接状态，默认 true；为 true 时会返回 statusCode/contentType/fileSize 等
最多返回候选数量，默认 20，最大 80
paramDesc_en: Page URL or direct file URL, http/https only
Optional expected file name or prefix such as app-release.apk, manual, report; used to construct candidates under the URL directory
Optional expected extensions as array or comma-separated string, such as apk,pdf,zip,docx
Optional keywords as array or comma-separated string, such as download, release, manual; used for ranking
Maximum candidates to return, default 20, max 80

apis.name: downloadFile
apis.desc: 下载指定文件 URL 到本地。适合已经从 analyzeDownloadCandidates/link_parser.extractDownloads 得到明确 url 后调用。默认保存到 /sdcard/PandaGenie/downloads；不要把网页 URL 直接传来下载，除非它本身就是文件直链。
apis.desc_en: Download a specific file URL. Use after analyzeDownloadCandidates or link_parser.extractDownloads returns a clear file URL. Defaults to /sdcard/PandaGenie/downloads; do not pass a normal HTML page unless it is itself a direct file URL.
paramDesc: 要下载的文件 URL，必须是 http/https
保存目录，默认 /sdcard/PandaGenie/downloads；用户指定目录时必须传目录路径
可选保存文件名；不传则从 Content-Disposition 或 URL 自动推断

最大允许下载字节数，默认 104857600(100MB)，防止误下超大文件；传 0 表示不限制
paramDesc_en: File URL to download, http/https only
Optional output file name; inferred from Content-Disposition or URL when empty
Overwrite existing file, default false; false auto-appends (1), (2)

apis.desc_en: Analyze a page/link and download the best matching file. Use when the user asks to open a link, find the APK/document/archive, and download it. If many candidates are ambiguous, call analyzeDownloadCandidates first for confirmation.

可选，期望扩展名，例如 apk,pdf,zip,docx；用户说安装包时传 apk，说压缩包时传 zip,rar,7z
可选，关键词，例如 下载,release,manual,arm64，用于排序
同名文件是否覆盖，默认 false
最大允许下载字节数，默认 104857600(100MB)，0 表示不限制
paramDesc_en: Page URL or direct URL to analyze and download
Optional expected file name or prefix
Optional expected extensions; use apk for app package, zip/rar/7z for archive, etc.
